hooks.name: Clinical review of the vitals mapping
hooks.description: Any change to how signals become vitals must keep the spec, the steering docs and the property-based tests in sync.

action.prompt: You just changed the clinical mapping. Before continuing: (1) re-read the Correctness Properties in .kiro/specs/codebase-ekg/design.md and confirm each still holds or update it deliberately; (2) make sure every property has a matching fast-check test in test/vitals.test.ts; (3) keep the mapping table in .kiro/steering/product.md and any LOINC codes in .kiro/steering/clinical-accuracy.md in sync with the code; (4) run pnpm check.
